source: JoSAA/CSAB official certificate formats and admission document guidance; institute reporting notices vary by institute

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.notes: The admit card used for the qualifying JEE Main exam

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.document: JEE Main Score Card / Rank Card
documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.notes: Official scorecard showing NTA score and All India Rank
Admit card of JEE Advanced exam
Official rank card showing CRL and category rank
Must show date of birth clearly
Both certificate (if result declared) and marksheet. If result not yet declared, submit admit card and submit certificate when available.

formats.OBC_NCL: Central Government format. Must be issued on or after April 1 of the admission year unless current official rules say otherwise.
formats.GEN_EWS: Central Government prescribed format. Must be issued on or after April 1 of the admission year unless current official rules say otherwise.

special_cases.Maharashtra_SC_OBC: Also need Caste Validity Certificate from Social Welfare Department
special_cases.Maharashtra_ST: Also need Caste Validity Certificate from Tribal Welfare Department
special_cases.Tamil_Nadu_ST: Must be from Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO)

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.notes: Must state disability type and percentage (minimum 40% for benchmark disability). Doctor's prescription also needed at physical reporting.

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.document: Crossed Bank Cheque / Passbook Image with Account Details
documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.notes: Bank account in candidate's name preferred. Shows IFSC code, account number, bank name.

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.required_for: IIT applicants (some IITs require at online stage)
documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.notes: Declaration of pre-existing ailments is compulsory

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.document: Seat Allotment Letter / Provisional Admission Letter
documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.required_for: All applicants (generated by JoSAA after allotment)
documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.notes: Download from JoSAA portal after each round allotment

documents_for_online_upload_after_allotm.document: Proof of Seat Acceptance Fee Payment

additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.specification: Recent, white background, same as used in JEE form

additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.required_for: HS (Home State) quota candidates at NITs
additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.purpose: Prove state of domicile matches JEE Main registered state

additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.required_for: Candidates from boards outside the state where NIT is located (varies by institute)
additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.notes: Required if coming from a different state board
Usually dated within 6 months of reporting

additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.required_for: Candidates with a gap year between 12th and JEE/college
additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.format: Notarized affidavit explaining gap (e.g., JEE preparation, medical reasons)
additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.notes: Some institutes require this even for JEE preparation gap
Usually generated online through www.antiragging.in. Print and submit.

additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.includes: Declaration of pre-existing conditions, vision, hearing, physical fitness

additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.when: Especially for income-based fee waivers (family income < 1 lakh or < 5 lakh)
additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.issuing_authority: District Magistrate / SDM / Tehsildar / competent authority
additional_documents_at_physical_reporti.validity: Issued on or after April 1 of admission year

document_upload_tips: Scan all documents at 300 DPI minimum. Higher resolution = better clarity.
Keep file sizes under 1MB per document (JPEG or PDF)
Ensure all text in document is readable after scanning
For certificates in regional language, provide English translation if available
Keep originals safe. You need them at physical reporting.
Make 3 sets of photocopies of all documents before reporting
Label all photocopies with your name and roll number

critical_certificate_deadlines.OBC_NCL_certificate: Must usually be issued on or AFTER April 1 of the admission year; verify the current JoSAA/CSAB certificate format.
critical_certificate_deadlines.EWS_certificate: Must usually be issued on or AFTER April 1 of the admission year; verify the current JoSAA/CSAB certificate format.
critical_certificate_deadlines.PwD_certificate: No expiry for permanent disability; periodic for temporary
critical_certificate_deadlines.explanation: OBC-NCL and EWS certificates expire each financial year. This is because creamy layer status and income can change. Always get a fresh certificate in the new financial year (April onwards).

document_verification_queries.what_are_queries: JoSAA may raise a 'query' if uploaded document is unclear, wrong format, or information mismatch
document_verification_queries.response_deadline: Must respond within 24-48 hours of query being raised (check portal daily)
document_verification_queries.how_to_respond: Upload corrected/clearer document as requested through JoSAA portal
